metadata.description: General-purpose agent skills, packaged by theme: hardware-lab (USB analysis and bench instruments), driver-porting (clean-room and source-anchored driver specs, board experts), agent-workflow (session learning, handoffs, loop safety, design partnership), dev-tools (Jujutsu, dependency scoring, CLI conventions). public-skills is all four in one.

plugins.name: hardware-lab
plugins.description: Bench and USB-analysis skills: Cynthion setup, capture, pcap decode and protocol reverse-engineering, USB device profiles, the MCCI 3411 test device, Bus Pirate, and Siglent oscilloscope control.

plugins.name: driver-porting
plugins.description: Driver porting and review: the clean-room pipeline (os-investigator, cleanroom-spec, cleanroom-implementer), source-anchored specs and reference reviews for code you own, and the Raspberry Pi 5 and Rockchip RK3588 board experts.

plugins.name: agent-workflow
plugins.description: Working with a coding agent over time: session learning and teaching summaries, wrap-ups and handoffs, transcript access, loop safety (intern-mode), design partnership, harness-agnostic skill authoring, and Google Docs review rounds.

plugins.name: dev-tools
plugins.description: Engineering utilities: Jujutsu (jj) in place of git, evidence-based dependency scoring (dep-quality), and conventions for CLIs that agents drive (cli-conventions).

plugins.name: public-skills
plugins.description: Every skill in this repo in one plugin: hardware-lab, driver-porting, agent-workflow and dev-tools combined. Install either this or the themed plugins, not both.
